svg.title: ObliviOS boot picture: loading texture
svg.desc: Repeats every 720 px; the renderer scrolls it at a fixed 240 px/s (one pass every 3.0 s). Only the rows behind the mask window matter. The renderer lines the bottom edge of this texture up with the bottom edge of the mask (GL y-up), so row y here is row y + 2144 of the mask: the window rows 2152 to 2156 are rows 8 to 12.
